# möbius for macOS 0.3.1

- Persistent Bot conversations keep project-only actions unavailable and preserve
  their permanent Bot identity when automatic chat naming completes.
- Open a Bot conversation by clicking its face or name in the compact avatar rail.
  Its transparent floating header lets messages scroll behind the Bot face and name.
- SVG icons stay white in dark mode and black in light mode. Accent button fills
  and Bot face colors remain in place.
- Choose a new chat's Bot from its header face menu. The composer keeps its folder
  control without a second Bot selector.

Requires Apple Silicon and macOS 26 or later, and gateway 0.16.1 (protocol 87).
